say:3:1520706001:1.text: What... what's going on?! Why is the cage empty?! Where are the <style="highlight">offerings</style> for the Herdmaster?!
say:3:1520706001:1.source_cn: 这……这是怎么回事？！为什么笼子是空的？！要献给狩猎神...
say:3:1520706001:1.male: What... what's going on?! Why is the cage empty?! Where are the <style="highlight">offerings</style> for the Herdmaster?!
say:3:1520706001:1.female: What... what's going on?! Why is the cage empty?! Where are the <style="highlight">offerings</style> for the Herdmaster?!

say:4:1520706002:0.text: We don't know! We just went to get some food and... when we got back, they're all gone!
say:4:1520706002:0.source_cn: 我们也不知道……我们只是去拿了点吃的东西，回来时祭品就...

say:5:1520706003:0.text: O great Hunting God, I beg your forgiveness!
say:5:1520706003:0.male: O great Hunting God, I beg your forgiveness!
say:5:1520706003:0.female: O great Hunting Goddess, I beg your forgiveness!

say:10:1520706005:1.text: Damn it. Had to be that brat Young Qin!
say:10:1520706005:1.source_cn: 可恶，肯定是奇那个混蛋小子干的！

say:11:1520706006:1.text: Hunting God, don't worry. I'll bring them back, all of them!
say:11:1520706006:1.source_cn: 狩猎神大人放心，我一定把奇和那些祭品都抓回来！
say:11:1520706006:1.male: Hunting God, don't worry. I'll bring them back, all of them!
say:11:1520706006:1.female: Hunting Goddess, don't worry. I'll bring them back, all of them!

say:12:1520706007:0.text: Nuzzle! Flame! You two, with me!
say:12:1520706007:0.source_cn: 娜，炎，你们两个也跟我一起去！

say:14:1520706008:0.text: Before you can say anything, the three of them take off, splitting up in a blur of motion.
say:14:1520706008:0.source_cn: 没给你反应的机会，三个人飞快地分头行动离开了。

say:15:1520706009:0.text: Herdmaster, you looked like you were about to say something.
say:15:1520706009:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人，您好像有话要说。
say:15:1520706009:0.male: Herdmaster, you looked like you were about to say something.
say:15:1520706009:0.female: Herdmaster, you looked like you were about to say something.

choice_prompt:16:1520706009.text: Herdmaster, you looked like you were about to say something.
choice_prompt:16:1520706009.source_cn: 狩猎神大人，您好像有话要说。
choice_prompt:16:1520706009.male: Herdmaster, you looked like you were about to say something.
choice_prompt:16:1520706009.female: Herdmaster, you looked like you were about to say something.

say:17:1520706010:1.text: But those offerings were carefully chosen.
say:17:1520706010:1.source_cn: 那些都是精挑细选的祭品。
say:17:1520706010:1.male: But those offerings were carefully chosen.
say:17:1520706010:1.female: But those offerings were carefully chosen.

say:19:1520706013:0.text: But it's so pretty. Why can't it be an offering?
say:19:1520706013:0.source_cn: 它这么漂亮，为什么不能当祭品？

say:20:1520706014:0.text: We already went over this. It wasn't picked.
say:20:1520706014:0.source_cn: 不行就是不行。而且献给狩猎神大人的祭品已经选完了。

say:23:1520706016:1.text: Would you like to check it out?
say:23:1520706016:1.male: Would you like to check it out?
say:23:1520706016:1.female: Would you like to check it out?

choice_prompt:24:1520706016.male: Would you like to check it out?
choice_prompt:24:1520706016.female: Would you like to check it out?

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 她们提到了献给狩……献给我的祭品

choice:24:1:2.text: I like a bit of noise...
choice:24:1:2.male: I like a bit of noise...
choice:24:1:2.female: I like a bit of noise...

choice:16:0:1.text: I was gonna call them off.
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 我本来想让他们别抓了
choice:16:0:1.male: I was gonna call them off.
choice:16:0:1.female: I was gonna call them off.

Even if they're animals?
I'm not sure I understand.
say:27:1520706011:0.source_cn: 用动物活祭，也不喜欢吗？\n加拉不太明白。
say:27:1520706011:0.male:
Even if they're animals?
I'm not sure I understand.
say:27:1520706011:0.female:

choice:16:2:3.source_cn: 都放跑了，还能抓回来吗？
